🍫 CHOCOLATE LOVERS, THIS ONE’S FOR YOU! 🤎🔥 If you love deep, rich chocolate with a silky-smooth finish, you NEED to try my 75% DARK CHOCOLATE CRÉMEUX! 😍 As a private chef, I believe the best desserts don’t always need complicated techniques or a hundred ingredients. Sometimes, it’s all about understanding the basics and letting quality ingredients do the talking. 👨‍🍳 This crémeux is made with just 5 ingredients, using a classic crème anglaise to create that beautiful, luxurious texture. No gelatine, no shortcuts — just proper technique and seriously good chocolate! 🍫👌 👨‍🍳 INGREDIENTS 🤎 For the crème anglaise: • 500ml whole milk • 250ml double cream • 150g egg yolks • 110g caster sugar 🍫 For the chocolate crémeux: • 335g 75% dark chocolate • All the crème anglaise from above 🔥 THE METHOD 1️⃣ Bring the milk and cream to the boil in a saucepan. 2️⃣ Whisk the egg yolks and sugar together in a separate bowl. 3️⃣ Gradually pour the hot milk and cream over the yolks, whisking continuously. 4️⃣ Return the mixture to a clean saucepan and cook gently, stirring constantly, until it reaches 82°C and coats the back of a spoon. Whatever you do, don’t let it boil! 5️⃣ Pour the hot crème anglaise over the chopped dark chocolate and blend until smooth, glossy and beautifully emulsified. 6️⃣ Pour into your chosen serving dishes and leave to chill until set. ✨ The result? A rich, intense chocolate dessert with an incredibly smooth, luxurious texture. 💬 LET’S TALK CHOCOLATE! Are you team 75% dark chocolate, or do you prefer something a little sweeter? Tell me in the comments! 👇 📌 SAVE this recipe for your next dinner party. 🔄 SHARE it with someone who takes their chocolate seriously! #privatechef #chocolatecremeux #chocolatedessert #chefs
